targetMilestone.metric: continuous-song strict exact-pitch onset micro-F1 at 100 ms

hypothesis: The p050 route-matched candidates modestly improved aggregate F1 but lost recall. Adding the already-reviewed p025 WANE domain bridge increases exposure to a harder vocal-mix input without changing the immutable base, validation songs, conditioning, seed, optimizer, token weights, or epoch count.

dataset.role: opened development and model selection; never sealed certification

control.reasonForControl: v003 has the identical model, route, optimizer, seed, and token weights; only the p025 curriculum addition changes.

singleChangedVariable.name: trainingManifest
singleChangedVariable.addedEvidence: 65 reviewed WANE p025 domain-bridge clips, retained under the same composition identity

gates: training loss must beat the immutable base on unconditioned validation
the internal decoded unconditioned multi-song panel must pass without recall regression
full 258-clip unconditioned micro-F1 must not regress at 100 ms or 250 ms
no validation song may lose more than 0.005 absolute 100 ms F1
duration, cutoff, overlong-note, frame, and rapid-retrigger limits must pass
the WANE trusted opening must improve after the frozen production-v004 arranger
manual blind listening must confirm cleaner phrasing before any deployment
rejectionPolicy: If any gate fails, preserve a hashed rejection receipt but no model checkpoint; do not deploy and do not change production routing.
